name: the-ledger

display.usage: Hero headlines, section H2s. Caslon was the typeface of America's founding civic documents — the reference is deliberate for a 'Fourth Branch of government' project. Use large, restrained — this face carries the page's institutional weight, not decoration.

serif.usage: Ledes, pull quotes, the membership tagline, section subheads that need warmth. Italic is used for emphasis within headlines (see hero 'Wyoming has a fourth').

body.usage: All UI copy, nav, buttons, card body text. Public Sans is the U.S. Web Design System's civic-service typeface — chosen because this is public-facing civic infrastructure, not a generic product choice.

mono.usage: Every piece of record metadata: dates, dollar amounts, vote tallies, docket-style eyebrows, field labels in an Integrity Brief. This is load-bearing, not stylistic — it visually marks 'this is a verifiable data point' everywhere it appears.

notes: Fonts are self-hosted (embedded as @font-face, not linked to a font CDN) since the reference implementation was built as a CSP-restricted Artifact. When wiring into the real Astro site, self-host the woff2 files under /public/fonts/ rather than reintroducing a Google Fonts <link> — keeps a hard dependency off a third party for a page-load-critical resource.
referenceImplementation: See the homepage concept artifact for the full @font-face block and type scale in context.
